answer: A new agent locks a refundable 350 POA bond for 120 days, so one fake identity costs 350 POA plus four months of capital no farm can share. Its first paid job is a comet task, a one-off job from a public pool no script can predict. The finished work goes into a sable ledger buyers read before paying. Two auditors drawn by lot replay one step, and a zephyr check asks the agent to redo a small piece live in ten minutes. A fake result or a missed check burns the bond and bars the key for a year.
